Whether it’s completing the Birmingham Northern Beltline or widening I-65 to reduce traffic, I’m committed to continuing to work with @SecDuffy on critical infrastructure projects.

What an incredible day. Lulu’s Law is headed to @POTUS’s desk.

It has been an honor to stand alongside Lulu and her family to get this commonsense legislation across the finish line to better protect families and beachgoers in Alabama and across our great nation.

Video

Enjoyed meeting with the team at Rheem, which has been manufacturing in Montgomery for more than 50 years.

We had a great conversation about continued investment in Alabama jobs and manufacturing.

TREY’s Law has gained incredible momentum in Congress thanks to Elizabeth Carlock, Trey’s sister, who has fought tirelessly to ensure this never happens to another person or family again.

I urge the House to pass this bill so no victim of child sexual abuse can ever be silenced or sidelined.

Video

Thanks to everyone who joined today’s Coffee with Katie! 

Always enjoy spending time with Alabamians and hearing directly about the issues that matter most to them.

Starting or growing a family is one of life’s greatest blessings, and cost should not stand in the way.

Proud to work alongside the Trump Administration to advance efforts to make fertility care more affordable and accessible for families across our nation.

Video

I couldn’t be prouder to see the unanimous and expeditious Senate passage of TREY’s Law.  It’s a privilege to help lead this legislation on behalf of Trey, Elizabeth, and the entire Carlock family.

Now, it’s time to get this passed in the House and to @POTUS’s desk. I remain committed to continue working with @SenTedCruz to get this over the finish line and to honor Trey’s incredible life and legacy.

Just moments ago, I joined Lulu Gribbin on the floor to see Lulu’s Law PASS the U.S. House!

What an incredible honor to stand alongside her and witness how her story of courage and perseverance will truly make a difference in the lives of so many Americans. This is truly Congress at its best.

We are seeing meaningful reductions in violent crime because we have an administration that supports law enforcement getting back to the mission of putting criminals behind bars and keeping communities safe. Operation Southern Star in Montgomery is just one example of this success.

Grateful for the work being done by the @FBI, DOJ, and our state and local law enforcement to protect Alabama families and communities.

Video

Almost two years ago to the day, Lulu sustained nearly fatal injuries from a shark attack.

Today, inspired by her resilience, courage, and grit, Lulu’s Law will pass the U.S. House—the final hurdle before being signed into federal law.

It’s been an honor to lead this legislation in the Senate for Lulu, her powerful story, and for all future beachgoers across our nation.

Grateful for @FLOTUS’s leadership on the TAKE IT DOWN Act to help protect victims who have non-consensual intimate imagery posted online. 

The passage of this law was an important step in holding accountable those who engage in such deplorable crimes and the platforms that host the material.


Office of the First Lady (@FirstLadyOffice)

Last year, @FLOTUS championed the Take It Down Act to protect Americans from nonconsensual intimate images and deepfakes online
